chapters.title: Evidence before fluency
chapters.text: LinguaFlow is an English tutor built around a distinction: a model may know an answer without having a supporting teaching reference. This walkthrough focuses on the Study freeform system.

chapters.title: A small, inspectable corpus
chapters.text: The repository contains two hundred teaching notes and one hundred seventy one English drills. Each note keeps its rule, examples, and boundaries together. Content validation and fingerprints make the index reproducible.

chapters.title: Retrieval, then selection
chapters.text: A question and optional card become a query embedding. Postgres retrieves ten vector candidates. A heuristic reranker combines cosine similarity with normalized metadata, then sends the top five to verification. This is not B M twenty five fusion.

chapters.title: A source is a claim
chapters.text: One verifier checks scope, missing context, and evidence support. It selects a supplied evidence identifier; the server restores the exact source text. Supported questions get a reference. Uncovered questions get a disclosure. Missing text triggers clarification.

chapters.title: Fail explicitly
chapters.text: Embeddings are prepared before atomic index publication. Readers check the active corpus fingerprint. In the freeform path, index and provider failures remain explicit service errors. Timeouts and bounded calls control failure behavior, without promising a production latency guarantee.

chapters.title: Freeze the comparison
chapters.text: The new evaluation compares verified and raw hybrid retrieval on one hundred frozen synthetic questions. Both arms use the same two hundred notes. Plans pin models, prompts, labels, and budgets. Offline replay reproduces scoring without new model calls.

chapters.title: Measure the trade-off
chapters.text: Using the frozen source labels, precision improves from thirty five point six percent to eighty six point four percent. The AI judge's correctness score improves from three point three seven to three point nine eight out of four. One baseline answer could not be graded.

chapters.title: Keep the failures visible
chapters.text: In one saved case, the verifier accepts a generic health note for the idiom under the weather. The judge also credits a disclosure that is absent. Shared models can make correlated mistakes. Frozen scores stay unchanged, with the audit alongside them.

chapters.title: What this demonstrates
chapters.text: The evidence demonstrates an implemented retrieval system, explicit failure handling, and a reproducible comparison. It does not establish learning gains or real user accuracy. Human review is pending, and the expanded corpus still needs coordinated production index publication.
